unit: vacant lots mowed and billed (approximate)
definition: Vacant lots Forestry 'mowed and billed' in the first rotation, out of about 14,000 lots 'on rotation', as stated by the city
label: reported
derivation: Read from the City's CityStat Forestry page text (data note: last updated 30 Jun 2026); not recomputed. The city counts a lot as mowed when it is billed, the same record DoneStat joins to.
source_sql_or_script: none (page text; phrase check in build/R3/voices-url-checks.csv)
note: Same page: Ward 13, 1,603 of 2,705 lots mowed (59.3%). The page also says some lots are skipped because already mowed by someone else.

unit: vacant-building parcels trimmed
period: 2026 cut season to 30 Jun 2026, in wards whose first rotation was complete
definition: Vacant-building parcels trimmed by contract crews, out of 4,638 vacant-building properties known in those wards; the first full rotation was not complete by 30 Jun 2026 against a goal of four rotations a season
label: reported
derivation: Read from the City's CityStat Forestry page text; not recomputed.
note: Context for 311 'weeds, vacant building' requests closed 'on schedule to be cut' a median 23 minutes after filing against a 90-day promise (N2).

unit: % of hazardous trees removed within 30 days
definition: City's own CityStat measure; goal is all validated hazardous trees within 30 days; 2024 and 2025 annual averages were below 20%
label: reported
derivation: Read from the City's CityStat launch release of 31 Mar 2026; not recomputed.
note: CityStat Forestry page attributes the miss to a backlog worked before new requests.

unit: % of CSB requests routed to the right department within 2.5 days
definition: CityStat's 311 measure: routing (dispatch to the responsible department), not completion; goal 95%
label: reported
derivation: Read from the City's CityStat launch release; the CSB page defines the measure as routing to the department responsible for completing the request.
note: Mayor at the 2 Apr 2026 launch: 'We are currently not meeting our goal to route 95% ...'

unit: average days to respond (Ward 1, Ward 10)
definition: CityStat CSB page: fastest and slowest ward average response time
label: reported
derivation: Read from the City's CityStat CSB page text; N3 reproduced the chart from the 311 file (ward 1 17.3, ward 10 32.2 on a slightly different window).
note: N3: type mix and closing words explain only 12% of the gap.

unit: date of the latest data on CityStat leaf pages
definition: Data note on the CityStat Towing, Forestry, CSB and Refuse pages: 'This data was last updated June 30th, 2026', with validated Q2 data promised for 1 Aug 2026
label: observed
derivation: Phrase found on four CityStat pages fetched 14 Oct 2026 (build/R3/voices-url-checks.csv). 106 days between 30 Jun and 14 Oct 2026 (my arithmetic).
note: Launch release promised quarterly updates. If CityStat publishes Q3 before Thursday this figure goes stale.

unit: stumps, hazardous trees in Forestry's backlog
definition: Backlog stated at the Budget and Public Employees Committee hearing of 30 Sep 2026
label: reported
retrieved: 2026-10-14 12:31 CDT (page); words from the saved auto-caption file

note: CityStat's own count of open hazard-tree work orders at 30 Jun 2026 was 591 (earlier session), a different measure.

unit: % of seasonal grass-cutting staffing capacity
definition: Forestry Division's written statement to First Alert 4: operating at about 60% of seasonal grass-cutting staffing; more than 20,000 vacant properties on rotation
label: reported

unit: % route completion (range), inferred by the city from missed-collection requests
definition: City's own estimate, made because route completion data 'was not recorded until September 2025'
label: reported
derivation: Read from the City's CityStat Refuse page; the city used 311 missed-collection requests as a stand-in completion record.
note: A city precedent for using 311 data to estimate completion.

unit: % change in shootings around treated vacant lots (95% CI -13.2 to -4.8)
definition: Philadelphia citywide cluster randomised trial, 541 vacant lots in 110 clusters: the 'mowing and trash cleanup' arm vs no-intervention control (greening arm: -6.8%, CI -10.6 to -2.7)
label: reported
derivation: Moyer, MacDonald, Ridgeway and Branas, American Journal of Public Health 2019;109(1):140-144, abstract (intention-to-treat difference-in-differences within the randomised trial). Not a St. Louis estimate: it bounds the benefit a routinely mowed lot delivers, which an uncut lot forgoes while uncut.
note: Closest randomised analogue to 311 'on schedule to be cut'. One city, 2013-15.

unit: % change in gun assaults (citywide intention-to-treat, greening)
period: 18 months before and after treatment in Apr-May 2013
definition: Branas et al. PNAS 2018: greening vs control, all neighbourhoods; the larger -29.1% is the any-treatment, below-poverty, compliance-adjusted estimate
label: reported
retrieved: 2026-10-14 (full text via Europe PMC PMC5866574, R3 agent A)
derivation: Branas et al., PNAS 2018;115(12):2946-2951, Tables 1-3, read in full text by an R3 research agent. Quote -29.1% only with its qualifiers (subgroup, compliance-adjusted).
note: Residents near greened lots: not going out over safety concerns -57.8% (P<=.05); perceived crime -36.8%.

unit: % change in residents reporting not going outside because of safety concerns
definition: Residents living near greened vacant lots vs control lots, Philadelphia cluster randomised trial (445 residents surveyed)
label: reported
retrieved: 2026-10-14 (full text via Europe PMC PMC5866574, R3 agent A)
derivation: Branas et al., PNAS 2018, resident survey results (significant for the full greening arm only, not for clean-up alone).
note: Greening is a heavier treatment than mowing; do not attach this figure to mowing alone.

unit: % change in gun assaults (95% CI -21.32 to -3.01)
definition: Philadelphia cluster randomised trial of abandoned houses (258 houses, 63 clusters): full remediation (working doors and windows, clean-up, weeding) vs control; clean-up and weeding alone had no significant effect; perceived safety unchanged
label: reported
retrieved: 2026-10-14 (abstract via Europe PMC PMID 36469329, R3 agent A; jamanetwork.com bars Claude agents)
derivation: South, MacDonald, Tam, Ridgeway and Branas, JAMA Internal Medicine 2023;183(1):31-39, abstract. Relative reduction: gun violence rose in every arm.
note: Securing the openings is what carried the effect; St. Louis board-ups after 'referred to board up crew': 19% within the 14-day promise, 71% within 90 days (N2).

unit: % change in firearm assaults around remediated abandoned buildings (CI -28 to -50)
definition: Philadelphia doors-and-windows ordinance remediation, 676 buildings vs matched controls; difference-in-differences; return per $1: $5 taxpayer, $79 society
label: reported
retrieved: 2026-10-14 12:31 CDT (publisher PDF via https://www.fs.usda.gov/nrs/pubs/jrnl/2016/nrs_2016_branas_001.pdf, R3 agent A)
derivation: Branas et al., American Journal of Public Health 2016;106(12):2158-2164, Results. Observational, not randomised; costs cited from earlier work.
note: Upper end of the building range; the randomised trial (South 2023) found -13%.

unit: assault rate ratio, street segments with lots mowed every three weeks vs unmaintained (CI 0.42-0.86)
definition: Flint, Michigan Clean & Green: 216 maintained vs 446 unmaintained street segments
label: reported
derivation: Heinze et al., American Journal of Community Psychology 2018;62:101; observational comparison, residents' groups mowed lots they chose.
note: About 40% fewer assaults; closest match on mowing dose, weakest design of the lot studies.

unit: % more service requests over the next 13 months (and 37.7% more categories)
definition: Boston Citizens Connect app users who received a photo of the completed work vs users whose request was only marked closed
label: reported
retrieved: 2026-10-14 12:25 CDT (HBS Working Paper 14-034 PDF, R3 agent C)
derivation: Buell, Porter and Norton, Manufacturing & Service Operations Management 2021;23(4):781-802: natural experiment with fixed-effects panel on 21,786 residents and 92,707 requests; not randomised.
note: Measures engagement, not whether work was done. A lab experiment in the same paper (n=125, randomised) found +14% trust and +12% support.

unit: 311 tickets closed before the work was completed (floor)
definition: Edmonton City Auditor: business areas closed tickets before completing the work; the 311 website defined closed as work 'assigned, scheduled, or completed'
label: reported
retrieved: 2026-10-14 12:32 CDT (R3 agent C); passage re-read 12:46 CDT
derivation: Edmonton City Auditor, 'City's Response to 311 Requests' audit, 14 Nov 2023. A floor because only about a third of tickets carried a documented closure reason.
note: Closest precedent found: an auditor measured closure before completion, and management accepted 'closed = resolved'.

unit: pothole complaints per street mile per parcel (under-reporting vs over-reporting areas)
definition: Kansas City, Missouri: areas that complain less than expected had worse pavement (48 vs 68) and lower satisfaction (2.15 vs 2.91 on 1-5); 54.7% vs 10.8% Black
label: reported
derivation: Kontokosta and Hong, Sustainable Cities and Society 2021;64:102503: actual vs expected complaints benchmarked to measured pavement condition; observational.
note: Same state as St. Louis. Pavement 48 in the text vs 43 in Table 2 (internal inconsistency).

unit: % of users who filed again, first report fixed vs not fixed
